newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan does not welcome wild forex moves - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan does not welcome wild forex moves - MOF.

text.p: Japan's monetary authorities do not welcome wild currency fluctuations, a senior Finance Ministry official told Reuters on Thursday.
The official declined to comment on specific exchange rate levels after the dollar rose above 115 yen briefly in Tokyo on Thursday.
"At any rate, Japanese monetary authorities do not welcome wild fluctuations in foreign exchnage rates," he said.
"We are keeping a close watch on currency developments," he said.
The ministry is closely monitoring whether Japan's trade surplus will keep rising after it showed the first year-on-year rise in two years in November, the official said.

The official said he does not think the ratio of Japan's trade surplus in relation to its gross domestic product will rise, partly because of structural changes, such as rising direct investment by Japanese companies abroad.
